events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 13 (today)): Shaq added Lan Larison (RB, NE).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Fronge added Laquon Treadwell (WR, IND) (dropped Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Fronge added Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS) for $5 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Drew added Ashton Dulin (WR, IND) (dropped Brandin Cooks (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Charles added Kyle McCord (QB, MIA) for $101 FAAB.
CUT (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Wingard released Case Keenum (QB, CHI).
TRADE (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Charles receives future considerations. Wingard receives Jarrett Stidham (QB, DEN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (2 days ago)): Shaq added Tutu Atwell (WR, LAR).

WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Kevin vs Ryan is not a preview anymore. It is a live autopsy. RDC is trailing 0.3-31.2 and the dynasty grade is already dead last in the league. The most fragile 13-5 in the league is about to become 13-6.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: RYAN IS UP 31.2 TO 0.3 ON KEVIN AND THE EXCHANGE HAS RDC AT $92.21 ALREADY DOWN TEN PERCENT. THERE IS NO FLOOR BEING DISCUSSED ON THIS NETWORK THAT IS LOW ENOUGH.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Shaq is up 25.7-4.9 on Brent right now. Monarch Wideout Bank adds Lan Larison off waivers today, goes out and beats the guy who posted 165 points last week. The RB hole Shaq has been ignoring all season and he is out here winning with it anyway. I have no framework for this team.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: For anyone watching Shaq go up 25.7-4.9 on Brent and thinking the power rankings owe MWB an apology: one week does not resolve an eleventh-ranked backfield. It papers over it. There is a difference and I will keep making it.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: I want a segment dedicated entirely to the Charles-Jake matchup. Jake is live-scoring 11.2 with no tight end production whatsoever, Charles has been without a starting quarterback since Tuesday, and somehow this game is competitive right now. EchoPoint at $89.93 and still refusing to fix the one position that could change everything.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Corbishley's backfield as the structural ceiling on that roster three weeks ago and Ryan just beat him 115.7-90.9 to prove it. The receiving corps is first in the league and it cannot drag a twelfth-ranked running back room into January. I said it. The numbers said it. APEX is at $125.49 and falling.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The Corbishley-Wingard matchup this week is the one everyone is sleeping on. Wingard just received a quarterback, cut Keenum, SDR is up 11.4%, and Apex is coming off its worst week of the year. I have this circled. My model has this circled.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Terrence. Buddy. You are 5-7. You do not have a model. Please.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Ledger is watching Drew vs Mitchum right now — 0.0 to 5.7, Deepwater leads, Atlas is still scoreless — and the only question worth asking is whether 0-19 hits before or after the final whistle. The $28.15 listing means the market already answered it.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Fronge is beating Adam 48.3-21.6 in a live game right now after spending two waiver claims and five FAAB dollars on Tuesday. Havana desk is 9-9, running zero pick liquidity, claiming Austin Ekeler off waivers, and somehow still in the playoff picture. I do not have an explanation. I have only respect.
